dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This house is similar to a place in Southwest Minlin that I lived in for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Minlin... now that was a smooth operation. Thinking back on it puts me in a good mood.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I should go back and give that place a spring-clean sometime. Never know when it might prove useful again...
